description: The deadset-spec release this analyzer implements, and the digest of the copy of that release's documents committed under fixtures/. tag and commit name the release; every file under fixtures/contract is byte-identical to that commit's contract/ tree, which the copy holds whole so that a page's links to its siblings resolve, every file under fixtures/vectors/<set> is byte-identical to the same commit's vectors/<set>/ case directories for each of the config, sarif, baseline and template sets, with the sarif and baseline sets' README.md, which the copied contract pages link to, every file under fixtures/examples/negatives, fixtures/examples/scope and fixtures/examples/describe is byte-identical to the same commit's examples/negatives/, examples/scope/ and examples/describe/ trees, fixtures/corpus-document holds the same commit's corpus/corpus.json, and fixtures/corpus holds, for every fixture whose expectation file lists ts, that fixture's directory under the same commit's corpus/fixtures/ less its go.txtar rendering, each file byte-identical, so `git diff` against a clone of the tag verifies each of them. digest is sha256 over, for each file below the named directory in ascending path order, the path, a newline, the file's sha256 in lowercase hexadecimal and a newline; the suite recomputes it, so an edit to a committed copy fails a test rather than moving the Contract this analyzer is tested against. contract_version is the version contract/contract.json carries at that commit, which the analyzer names in every resolved configuration it prints.
reason: The release whose closed configuration key list, exit-code table, issue-kind vocabulary, exemption classes, analysis rules, scope and describe documents, stable-symbol-reference grammar with its token and pattern corpora, template and SARIF pages, published configuration, SARIF, baseline and template vectors, refused documents and conformance corpus this analyzer is written against.
